subject.title: Placentia — Measure L (Placentia Hotel Tax Measure)

text: Shall the measure increasing the rate of the City of Placentia’s existing transient occupancy tax (hotel tax), paid only by hotel guests, to 14%, funding city services such as police patrols, fire protection, 911 response, and road repairs; requiring citizen oversight and annual audits, generating about $715,000 annually, until ended by voters, be adopted?
A YES vote approves the ordinance increasing the rate of the Hotel Tax to 14%.
A NO vote rejects the ordinance, and would leave the Hotel Tax at 10%.

analysis.title: Impartial Analysis

text: The City of Placentia currently imposes a 10% transient occupancy tax on transients (hotel guests) who occupy a hotel room for 30 consecutive days or less. This tax is commonly referred to as the City’s “Hotel Tax.” It is collected by the hotel operator (or their agent) from the guest based on the “rent” charged for lodging. The hotel operator then remits the collected tax to the City.

For purposes of the Hotel Tax, “hotel” is broadly defined to include “any structure, or any portion of any structure, which is occupied or intended or designed for occupancy by transients for dwelling, lodging or sleeping purposes.” Thus, short-term rentals of homes or of rooms in homes would be subject to the tax.

Proceeds of the Hotel Tax are deposited in the general fund and available for any lawful municipal purpose. Examples of services funded through the general fund include neighborhood police patrols, fire protection, 911 response, and road repairs. The City’s accounts, including the general fund, are audited annually by an independent auditor.

Measure L seeks voter approval of an ordinance that increases the rate of the Hotel Tax to 14%. The ordinance requires that, in addition to independent annual audits of tax proceeds and expenditures, the City’s existing Citizens’ Oversight Committee review expenditures of funds generated by the Hotel Tax and prepare an annual report of such expenditures.
The measure was placed on the ballot by the City Council of the City of Placentia. To be adopted, this measure requires the approval of a majority of the voters casting ballots.
A YES vote approves the ordinance increasing the rate of the Hotel Tax to 14%.
A NO vote rejects the ordinance, and would leave the Hotel Tax at 10%.
